svg.title: Hangul: 19 initials, 21 vowels and 28 final slots assemble into two-dimensional syllable blocks

g.text: Hangul: alphabetic Jamo assemble by role into 2D syllable blocks.
19 initials × 21 vowels × 28 final slots (27 + none) → 11,172 precomposed blocks; one formula recovers the parts.
Structure is hidden in this layer
COMPOSITION SPACE · 11,172 PRECOMPOSED BLOCKS FROM 67 POSITIONAL JAMO
··· 10,788 SYLLABLES OMITTED · ONE REGULAR COMPOSITION SPACE ···
Precomposition is convenient; the Jamo structure stays recoverable
Each syllable places an initial, a vowel and an optional final in 2D.
Does Jamo splitting help? Close to a tie on tokens; model-side gain untested.
